title: Deterministic Scoring Engine
description: Generate transparent, explainable, deterministic scores across seven policy outcome categories, with a configurable weighting system and per-score rationale. No AI anywhere in the scoring path.
rationale: Scores let users compare scenarios at a glance and underpin leaderboards and AI critique. Keeping scoring deterministic and AI-free makes results reproducible and defensible - the platform's core integrity guarantee.
success_criteria: All seven categories produce a deterministic score for a given model
Identical inputs always yield identical scores (verified by test)
Each score is accompanied by a human-readable rationale
Weightings are externally configurable and documented
No code path in scoring imports an AI provider
notes:
## Scope (in)
- Categories: Fiscal Sustainability, Economic Growth, Poverty Reduction, Income Equality, NHS Demand Impact, Housing Affordability, Implementation Complexity
- Configurable score-weighting system
- Score rationale output
- No AI dependency

## Out of scope
- AI-generated commentary on scores (EPIC-010)
- Cross-user ranking UI (EPIC-007)
- Distributional inputs to scoring (EPIC-013, later refinement)

## Dependencies
- EPIC-001 - scores consume engine outputs
- EPIC-002 - presets provide calibration/sanity-check reference points

## Assumptions
- Each category is a deterministic function of inputs and engine outputs
- Weightings are explicit and documented, not hidden constants
- Scores normalised to a common documented scale (e.g. 0-100)

## Risks
- Arbitrary-seeming weightings -> document every weight + rationale; configurable
- Category formulas encode bias -> publish methodology; neutral framing
- Ideological scoring of subjective concepts -> fairness, desirability and political acceptability are NOT scored as fixed categories; they are expressed via configurable weighting profiles (FEATURE-003-US-007)
- Scores misread as objective truth -> always pair score with rationale + caveat
- Non-determinism creeps in -> forbid randomness/AI; test determinism

## Future extensions
- Confidence/uncertainty bands per score (links to EPIC-012)
- Distributional adjustments once EPIC-013 lands
- User-selectable weighting profiles surfaced in EPIC-007
